description: Residential proxy packs and a raw HTTP fetch for AI agents: buy gigabytes of traffic and get a proxy login, or fetch one URL from a residential IP. This A2A agent is free and read-only: it answers questions about the API and explains which endpoint fits a task and how to get its quote. It places no paid calls, signs no payments and holds no accounts. Paid calls go over HTTP (https://agproxy.shveik.dev/openapi.json) or MCP (https://agproxy.shveik.dev/mcp), paid in stablecoins.

Free; it runs no scraping.
